summary: Preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @servicetitan/widget-platform-monolith@5.6.4 declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the package-local `math_init.js` — a ~727 KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) whose contents are heavily obfuscated (rotated string-array cipher with a shuffler function, hex-mangled `_0x...` identifiers, mixed-type lookup tables). setup.mjs itself is also control-flow-obfuscated with per-call hex-name string-property tables that hide plain method names and constants. The alternate-runtime dispatch means the payload never runs under Node and is opaque to Node-based scanners; the package is otherwise a thin React widget library of trivial re-export shims for which a compiled Bun bundle is not a customary distribution format. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: installing the package auto-executes attacker-shaped opaque code under a fetched second-language runtime at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
